subject: Speaker data path: 16-bit chain, NGD channel removal fix, mono RX1 and per-stream SLIMbus delivery failures

kernels.r31: r30 without the 24-bit back-end pin, plus a TEST log of the AFE SLIMbus config
kernels.r32: r31 + slimbus: qcom-ngd-ctrl: Remove stream channels when disabling a stream
kernels.r33: r32 + TEST mono playback (back-end fixup allows 1 channel, AFE channel map follows the stream, codec DAI channels_min 1)

findings: 16-bit SLIMbus AFE starts now succeed (they failed earlier); AFE config is version 1, device 0, format 0, RX channels 144/145, TX 128/129

NGD bug: qcom_slim_ngd_xfer_msg() drops all core reconfiguration messages and the controller has no disable_stream, so stream channels were never removed at the ADSP manager. Without removal, a stream at a different sample width than the previous one failed with ADSP error 1 (r31); with the new disable_stream (SLIM_USR_MC_CHAN_CTRL remove + RECONFIG_NOW, as downstream) 16- and 24-bit streams follow each other (r32). Clean commit: fx0-linux integration/fx0-ngd-disable-v2 c4e259382709

Stock plays mono: only SLIM RX1 carries AIF1_PB and RX3 mixes RX1 alone. With r33, mono into RX1 alone reaches the speaker (mic -23 dBFS at -10 dB digital gain) - the first time RX1 has carried audio on mainline
Each stream is all-or-nothing: the tone either plays for its full length or the stream is silent from the start

With capture restarted before each play about half the plays work, in clusters; with one continuous capture across eight plays none worked. RX channel activation itself mostly fails and successes coincide with other reconfigurations (e.g. a TX stream starting)
The codec's SLIMbus port interrupt status latches PORT_CLOSED on RX 16/17 and TX 0/1 and is never cleared (no interrupt handling in the driver), but working plays also show it set
next: instrument the NGD define/activate/reconfigure messages and ADSP replies per stream
compare with downstream ordering: SLIM_USR_MC_REQ_BW before defining channels, codec channel activation relative to the AFE port start
once delivery is reliable: mono speaker path (RX1 only) as on stock, then the owner's listening check
measurement: Main microphone at 16-bit (clean floor near -110 dBFS) recording a 1 kHz tone played through hw:0,0; scripts in local/mic (private)

experiments_r34_r38.method: Eight mono plays into RX1 (as stock) per configuration, each recorded by the main mic at 16-bit; 1 kHz present (#) or absent per 100 ms; TEST logs of AFE config/device start, NGD DEF_ACT_CHAN/CHAN_CTRL results and codec trigger timing
experiments_r34_r38.message_sequence: Identical for delivered and silent streams: AFE slim cfg + DEVICE_START (ret 0), CONNECT_SINK, DEF_ACT_CHAN (ret 0) about 30 ms later at trigger, RECONFIG_NOW, removal at stop (ret 0)
ruled_out: DEF_ACT_CHAN contents (presence rate 0x83, segment length, coefficient/exponent identical to downstream)
port watermark/enable value (0x05) and interface register addresses (Taiko-type bases)
codec MCLK rate handling (9.6 MHz assumed; the RPM reports the XO default)
activation timing after the AFE start
experiments_r34_r38.interpretation: Activation only ever works when it happens after the front-end stream has been triggered, and then about half the time regardless of delay; a remaining state difference between the ADSP side and the codec port decides each stream
experiments_r34_r38.phone_state: r37 TEST kernel installed (fx0-s16-test with slim_early/slim_delay_ms parameters at 0 = current behaviour)

experiments_r39.changes: TEST: AFE_PARAM_ID_CDC_SLIMBUS_SLAVE_CFG sent once to the DSP (WCD9306 enumeration address 0x0217/0x00e00100, TX offset 0, RX offset 16; DSP returned 0), and the codec's SLIMbus port interrupt status cleared before and after every stream
experiments_r39.results: 9/16 and 6/8 mono plays delivered, still in runs; codec port status (0x34-0x37, sources 0x60/0x70) stays 0 during both delivered and silent streams - a silent stream never reaches the codec port as data, so the codec cannot detect it
also_ruled_out: the downstream AFE codec slave description
NGD register layout (v1.5.0 offset 0x1000 matches downstream for an odd instance)
downstream slim_query_ch (local bookkeeping only, no bus message)

experiments_r40_r41.capture_check: Silent plays still show live capture (about 70 distinct noise values, RMS about 10 before the tone), so the mic detector is valid and the failures are on the playback side
experiments_r40_r41.keep_channel_active (r40, mode 3): After the first activation the channel is never removed. Boot A: first play delivered, plays 2-8 silent; boots B and C: all 8 silent. A delivering setup does not persist across AFE port restarts
experiments_r40_r41.reactivate_while_running (r41, mode 4): Normal activation at trigger, then remove and redefine the channel 100 ms later: 0/8 (normal mode in the same session 5/8)
experiments_r40_r41.model: The DSP attaches its AFE source port to the SLIMbus channel only at the first channel activation after the front-end stream is triggered, and then roughly half the time; activation before that, a kept channel, or a later redefinition never attaches
experiments_r40_r41.phone_state: r41 TEST kernel installed; wcd9306 slim_early defaults to 0 (normal behaviour)
